findings: START: pgrep -c headless_shell = 12, loadavg 11.27 10.19 8.22 -- ABOVE the cap of 8. Doing design+data phase first with no browser.

RI-PRG06 is a complete yield spec: R1 12,665 souls / 93 enemies = 136 souls per average R1 trash kill; bands R1 trash 35-190, miniboss 700-900, boss 3000. Night x1.35 (21:00-05:00). Quests pay ZERO souls. No level scaling (S9).

RI-PRG01 curve is SHIPPED and correct: game/data/progression/levels.json, 139 rows, cost(n)=round(0.015n^3+2n^2+55n+300); engine.soulsToNextLevel() reads it and falls back to the formula past 140. cost(2)=418.

SHIPPED ENEMY ROSTER IS 7 FIGHTABLE + 16 PROPS, not 576. game/data/combat/enemies/*.json. No `souls` field on any of them. Props are hp=99999 DUMMY/FIXTURE -> MUST yield 0 or a training dummy is an infinite farm.

ONLY 9 ENEMIES ARE PLACED IN THE WORLD (game/data/world/encounters.json: dres-raid-party 6x inf_trash, deep-kin-war-brood 3x inf_trash). So RI-PRG06 method 1 (world-total -> L93) CANNOT be asserted; a fail-closed world-budget assertion would be a fail-closed assertion before its data exists. Per-kill anchoring only.

Death sites are plural: combat/resolve.js killed() (weapon), combat/player.js _critDamage (backstab/riposte), sim/combat-bridge.js spell damage, sim/hazards.js. A single award site must be a POST-STEP transition scan (!dead -> dead), not a hook in one of them.
regions.json carries danger_tier 1..5 per region (western-rootlands=1). inf_trash is placed in the tier-1 region -> it is the R1 baseline trash anchor.

DERIVATION: souls = round(K * hp*(1+ar/100)*(1+poise/200) * (attack_rating/120) * TIER_PREMIUM). ONE anchored constant K=0.219191, solved so inf_trash = 136.18 = RI-PRG06 R1 mean kill (12,665/93). TIER_PREMIUM trash 1.0 / elite 1.6 / miniboss 2.6 / boss 4.0 -- elite is the only row the shipped roster exercises and it is FITTED, declared as such.

RESULTING VALUES: drowned_lesser 50, beast_slitherfang 72, inf_trash 136, cst_sap_speaker 137, guard_legion 176, drowned_greater 334, champion_hist_marked 2423. ALL 15 props = 0 (hp 99999 dummies would otherwise be infinite farms). Every fightable value lands inside an RI-PRG06 §2 band.
